##############################################################################
# OSS-Fuzz
##############################################################################

# The following targets realize the integration to OSS-Fuzz.
# See <https://github.com/google/oss-fuzz/blob/master/projects/json/build.sh> for more information.

# additional flags
CXXFLAGS += -std=c++11
CPPFLAGS += -I ../single_include

FUZZER_ENGINE = src/fuzzer-driver_afl.cpp
FUZZERS = parse_afl_fuzzer parse_bson_fuzzer parse_cbor_fuzzer parse_msgpack_fuzzer parse_ubjson_fuzzer parse_bjdata_fuzzer
fuzzers: $(FUZZERS)

parse_afl_fuzzer:
	$(CXX) $(CXXFLAGS) $(CPPFLAGS) $(FUZZER_ENGINE) src/fuzzer-parse_json.cpp -o $@

parse_bson_fuzzer:
	$(CXX) $(CXXFLAGS) $(CPPFLAGS) $(FUZZER_ENGINE) src/fuzzer-parse_bson.cpp -o $@

parse_cbor_fuzzer:
	$(CXX) $(CXXFLAGS) $(CPPFLAGS) $(FUZZER_ENGINE) src/fuzzer-parse_cbor.cpp -o $@

parse_msgpack_fuzzer:
	$(CXX) $(CXXFLAGS) $(CPPFLAGS) $(FUZZER_ENGINE) src/fuzzer-parse_msgpack.cpp -o $@

parse_ubjson_fuzzer:
	$(CXX) $(CXXFLAGS) $(CPPFLAGS) $(FUZZER_ENGINE) src/fuzzer-parse_ubjson.cpp -o $@

parse_bjdata_fuzzer:
	$(CXX) $(CXXFLAGS) $(CPPFLAGS) $(FUZZER_ENGINE) src/fuzzer-parse_bjdata.cpp -o $@

part.text:
Fixed. The enum `to_json` overload now dispatches on the signedness of the enum's underlying type instead of always constructing a `number_integer`:

- include/nlohmann/detail/conversions/to_json.hpp:318 — uses `std::is_signed<underlying_type>` to pick `value_t::number_unsigned` + `number_unsigned_t` for unsigned enums, keeping the old behavior for signed ones.
- single_include/nlohmann/json.hpp:5699 — same fix in the amalgamated header.

Validation:
- `test-udt_cpp11` (which now includes the `book_id : uint64_t` large-value checks) passes.
- `test-conversions`, `test-constructor1/2`, `test-bson`, `test-msgpack`, `test-cbor`, `test-ubjson`, `test-bjdata` all pass.
- A standalone program compiled against both `single_include` and `include` confirms `json(book_id(1<<63)).is_number_unsigned()` and dumps as `9223372036854775808`.
